title: PC-NFPSO chronological-validation size and development run-failure semantics
reason: The Gate-2 freeze specifies that PC-NFPSO uses a fitting segment followed by chronological validation, but it does not explicitly freeze the PC-NFPSO validation-tail size. The baseline-tuning validation formula is baseline-specific and must not be silently reused. Development-run failure handling also affects whether a radius-alpha pair can enter selection and is therefore frozen here before any development outcome is generated.

pc_nfpso_validation.scope: all V2 PC-NFPSO base-model training runs unless an ablation explicitly states otherwise
pc_nfpso_validation.pretest_supervised_rows: N = len(raw_pretest) - L after the frozen contiguous lag construction
pc_nfpso_validation.chronology: the last V supervised rows of the pre-test window are validation; all earlier supervised rows are fitting
pc_nfpso_validation.scaler_rule: A004 applies unchanged: fit the scaler only through the final fitting target, then freeze it for validation, optimization, full-pretest consequent refit, and test forecasting
pc_nfpso_validation.distinction_from_baselines: This is the PC-NFPSO method-validation rule. It is not the baseline inner-tuning formula V=min(max(5,ceil(0.20*N_train)), N_train-L-10).
pc_nfpso_validation.inheritance_note: The max(8, floor(0.20*N)) rule is the leakage-aware V1 research-baseline PC-NFPSO validation rule, now made explicit for V2 before development.

synthetic_development_split.split: first 144 observations are pre-test training; final 36 observations are test
synthetic_development_split.lag_rule: L=min(12,max(5,m)) using the frozen generator seasonal period m

development_accuracy.mase_denominator: mean(abs(y_train[t]-y_train[t-m])) over the raw pre-test training window only
development_accuracy.forecast_policy: fixed fitted parameters; append observed true test value after each one-step forecast

development_run_failure_policy.logging: record deterministic run_id, stage, exception type, and exception message
development_run_failure_policy.selection_gate: Global radius-alpha selection is prohibited unless every expected development run has succeeded with a finite non-negative MASE.
development_run_failure_policy.rationale: A failed run is an operational result, not an accuracy value. Converting failures to an arbitrary MASE penalty or dropping them could change hyperparameter selection.

scientific_effect: Clarifies an inherited PC-NFPSO validation rule and fail-closed selection semantics before any V2 development or final performance outcome is generated or inspected.
